sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MEAN LONGWAVE PATTERN WILL REMAIN DOMINATED BY WESTERN STATES UPPER RIDGE...WITH MEAN TROUGHING OVER THE EASTERN HALF OF THE CONUS. WITH RESPECT TO DEEP CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL TODAY...PRIMARY SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS EXPECTED TO DIG SOUTHEASTWARD FROM ONTARIO TOWARD TO THE UPPER MIDWEST/GREAT LAKES REGION...WHILE A LEAD MID LEVEL IMPULSE PIVOTS EAST-NORTHEASTWARD OVER THE NORTHEAST STATES. ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT WILL DEVELOP SOUTHEASTWARD OVER THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY/MIDWEST...WITH THE WESTERN PORTION OF THE FRONT SPREADING SOUTHWARD ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY/CORN BELT
sections.text: AS AFOREMENTIONED SHORTWAVE TROUGH/SPEED MAX DIGS SOUTHEASTWARD FROM ONTARIO TO THE WESTERN GREAT LAKES/UPPER MIDWEST...ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT WILL SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD DURING THE DAY...REACHING PORTIONS OF NORTHERN WI/FAR SOUTHERN MN AND NORTHEAST NEB BY EARLY/MID AFTERNOON. AHEAD OF THE FRONT AND/OR ON THE SOUTHWEST PERIPHERY OF REMNANT EARLY DAY TSTMS ACROSS MN/WI...A MOIST AIRMASS WILL ADVECT NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE CORN BELT...WITH A MODERATELY UNSTABLE/WEAKLY CAPPED AIRMASS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. AS LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT OVERSPREADS THE REGION...IT SEEMS PROBABLE THAT TSTMS SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE SOUTHEAST ADVANCING COLD FRONT OR PREFRONTAL TROUGH. STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WITH HEIGHT/STRENGTHENING FLOW ALOFT WOULD SUPPORT AN INITIAL MODE OF SUPERCELLS AMIDST 40-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...ALTHOUGH THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT/LINEAR FORCING SHOULD ULTIMATELY RESULT IN A BROKEN SQUALL LINE WITH POSSIBLE SMALL BOWING SEGMENTS AS STORMS DEVELOP SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH EARLY/MID EVENING. SEVERE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARDS...BUT SUFFICIENT LOW LEVEL SRH WITH 100-200 M2/S2 WOULD SUPPORT PO

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: STORMS MAY FORM ACROSS PORTIONS OF NEB/EASTERN WY AND PERHAPS FAR SOUTHWEST SD/FAR NORTHEAST CO IN VICINITY OF SOUTHWARD MOVING COLD FRONT AND/OR EARLY ONSET OF LOW LEVEL UPSLOPE INTO EASTERN WY/NORTHEAST CO FRONT RANGE AND ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS. CAPPING ALONG/SOUTH OF THE FRONT AND THE INITIAL/LATE DAY ONSET OF UPSLOPE TRAJECTORIES PRECLUDES A CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK AT THIS TIME. HOWEVER...STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILES/STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WOULD SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLS WITH MAINLY SEVERE HAIL THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING.

sections.title: NORTHEAST STATES/DELMARVA TO CAROLINAS/GA
sections.text: LEAD MID LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL OVERSPREAD THE UPPER OH VALLEY AND PA/NY TODAY...ACCOMPANIED BY RELATIVELY COOL MID LEVEL TEMPERATURES /AROUND -14C AT 500 MB/ AND A MODERATE BELT OF WESTERLY FLOW /40 KT AT 500 MB/ ACROSS THE DELMARVA VICINITY. THE EARLY DAY TIMING OF THE MID LEVEL TROUGH AND ONSET OF WESTERLY FLOW WILL LEAD TO A DRYING BOUNDARY LAYER IN MOST LOCALES EXCEPT THE COASTAL PLAIN/SEABOARD...BUT IT SEEMS PROBABLE THAT SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY WILL DEVELOP FOR AN UPSWING IN TSTMS BY EARLY AFTERNOON. EVEN WITH RELATIVELY COOL MID LEVEL TEMPERATURES AND MODERATE FLOW ALOFT ESPECIALLY ACROSS PA/NY AND DELMARVA VICINITY...TIMING OF THE MID LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND MODEST CONVERGENCE/TENDENCY FOR LOW LEVEL VEERING PUTS THE EXTENT/MAGNITUDE OF THE SEVERE THREAT IN QUESTION. REGARDLESS...PORTIONS OF THE REGION MAY ULTIMATELY WARRANT A CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK IN SUBSEQUENT DAY 1 OUTLOOKS. ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS/PERHAPS HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AS FAR SOUTH AS SC/GA.

sections.title: NORTHERN GREAT DIVIDE
sections.text: CLOSED UPPER LOW WILL MIGRATE SLOWLY EASTWARD OVER THE NORTHERN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION TODAY. WHILE A PARTICULARLY ORGANIZED/WIDESPREAD SEVERE THREAT IS NOT EXPECTED...RESIDUAL UPPER COLD POCKET AND STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT MAY SUPPORT HAIL TO SEVERE LEVELS WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS ACROSS THE NORTHERN GREAT DIVIDE VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. ..GUYER/SMITH.. 07/24/2009

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER A SMALL PART OF WRN MT
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... FAIRLY POTENT UPR LOW NOW OVER WRN ONTARIO WILL MOVE SE TO CNTRL LK SUPERIOR THIS PERIOD AS ASSOCIATED JET STREAK NOW ALONG THE SK/MB BORDER SWEEPS SSE INTO SRN MN. IN THE MEAN TIME...RIDGE WILL REMAIN ANCHORED OVER THE FOUR CORNERS REGION WHILE SEVERAL DISTURBANCES /MOST NOTABLY THOSE NOW OVER OH AND CAPE COD/ MOVE E/NE WITHIN BROAD TROUGH IN THE EAST. AT THE SFC...UPR MS VLY COLD FRONT WILL PROGRESS STEADILY SE...REACHING THE UPR MI/CNTRL WI/CNTRL IA AND SRN NEB BY EVE. THE FRONT SHOULD CONTINUE SE INTO LWR MI/CNTRL IL AND SRN KS BY 12Z SAT AS DIFFUSE WARM FRONT NOW ALONG THE IA/NEB BORDER MOVES E INTO IND/WRN OH.

sections.title: UPR/MID MS VLY TO LK MI
sections.text: WIND PROFILES WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS OVER PARTS OF IA/SRN MN AND WI LATER TODAY AS ONTARIO UPR VORT AND ASSOCIATED FRONTAL SYSTEM CONTINUE SEWD. SATELLITE/GPS AND SFC DEWPOINT DATA SHOW THAT REGION REMAINS ONLY MODESTLY MOIST FOR JULY /PW AOB 1.25 INCHES/ IN WAKE OF UPR SYSTEM THAT AMPLIFIED OVER THE OZARKS EARLIER THIS WEEK. NONETHELESS...AMPLE MOISTURE WILL BE PRESENT TO SUPPORT STORM DEVELOPMENT IN CONFLUENT LOW LVL WSWLY FLOW ALONG AND AHEAD OF COLD FRONT THIS AFTN THROUGH TONIGHT AS LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT MARKEDLY STRENGTHENS ACROSS REGION. STRONGLY-VEERING WIND PROFILES AND TEMPORAL STRENGTHENING OF MID/UPR FLOW SHOULD SUPPORT A DECIDEDLY SUPERCELLULAR INITIAL STORM MODE. WITH SBCAPE RANGING FROM 2500 TO 3500 J/KG AMIDST 40-50 KT DEEP NWLY SHEAR...STORMS LIKELY WILL YIELD BOTH LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND. AMPLE LOW LVL SRH WILL ALSO BE PRESENT FOR TORNADOES...MAINLY EARLY IN STORM LIFE CYCLES THROUGH AROUND SUNSET. WITH TIME...LINEAR FORCING OF COLD FRONT SHOULD FAVOR EVOLUTION INTO A BROKEN SQUALL LINE. EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS/BOWING SEGMENTS LIKELY WILL CONTINUE TO PRODUCE HAIL AND WIND AS THEY MOVE/DEVELOP SEWD THROUGH MID EVENING. FORWARD-PROPA

sections.title: CNTRL PLNS/HI PLNS
sections.text: WDLY SCTD STORMS MAY FORM THIS AFTN AND EVE INVOF COLD FRONT/PREFRONTAL TROUGH AND IN ZONE OF DEVELOPING UPSLOPE FLOW OVER NEB/ERN WY AND POSSIBLY FAR SW SD/NE CO. CIN CONSIDERATIONS AND ABSENCE OF DEEP FORCING FOR ASCENT PRECLUDE A CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK ATTM. HOWEVER...STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILES AND STEEP LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES WOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH A THREAT FOR SVR HAIL IF SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS DO INDEED FORM.

sections.title: ERN STATES
sections.text: OH SHORTWAVE TROUGH SHOULD PIVOT ENE ACROSS ENE ACROSS NY/PA/MD LATER TODAY...REACHING THE HUDSON VLY BY EVE...ACCOMPANIED BY SEASONABLY COOL MID LVL TEMPERATURES /AROUND -14C AT 500 MB/ AND A BELT OF MODERATE /30-40 KT/ WLY FLOW. DEPARTING CAPE COD SYSTEM LIKELY WILL RESULT IN SOME LOW LVL DRYING AND POSSIBLY WEAK DIVERGENCE OVER PARTS OF NY/PA FOR SOME TIME TODAY. NEVERTHELESS...SUFFICIENT MOISTURE WILL REMAIN AVAILABLE TO SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF TSTMS AHEAD OF THE OH VORT AS IT CROSSES PARTS OF THE MID ATLANTIC REGION DURING MAX SFC HEATING LATER TODAY. RELATIVELY EARLY TIMING OF THE OH TROUGH AND PROXIMITY OF CAPE COD SYSTEM SUGGEST THAT THE STRONGEST STORMS MAY OCCUR OVER A NARROW CORRIDOR FROM NERN MD/DE AND ERN PA INTO NJ AND SERN NY. PARTICULARLY IN THIS REGION...A FEW STORMS ORGANIZED INTO SHORT LINES/CLUSTERS MAY YIELD SVR HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG WIND THROUGH EARLY EVE. FARTHER S...MORE ISOLD STRONG TO BRIEFLY SVR STORMS MAY OCCUR ALONG RESIDUAL COLD FRONT/LEE TROUGH FROM SE VA AND THE ERN CAROLINAS INTO ERN GA.

sections.title: NRN GREAT DIVIDE
sections.text: COMPACT CLOSED LOW EXPECTED TO REMAIN NEARLY STNRY OVER ERN WA THIS PERIOD. TSTMS HAVE PERSISTED OVERNIGHT WITHIN WARM CONVEYOR BELT E OF LOW...AND LIKELY WILL INTENSIFY/INCREASE IN NUMBER WITH SFC HEATING LATER TODAY. ASSOCIATED POCKET OF SEASONABLY COOL MID LVL TEMPERATURES /AOB MINUS 12C AT 500 MB/...AND BAND OF 30-40 KT SSWLY MID LVL FLOW SUGGEST THE POSSIBILITY OF A FEW SUSTAINED STORMS AND POSSIBLY A HIGH-BASED SUPERCELL OR TWO WITH HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG WIND OVER WRN MT AND NRN ID THIS AFTN THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT. ..CORFIDI/GRAMS.. 07/24/2009

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS IN THE NRN GREAT DIVIDE... ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PORTIONS OF NY/PA SEWD INTO DELMARVA...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER LOW OVER WRN ONTARIO WILL MOVE SEWD INTO LAKE SUPERIOR TONIGHT. THIS SYSTEM WILL EJECT UPPER LOWS OVER LAKE ERIE AND IN SRN NEW ENGLAND NEWD THROUGH THE PERIOD. UPPER RIDGE WILL REMAIN IN THE WEST....WITH A CLOSED QUASI-STATIONARY LOW ALOFT SITUATED IN THE ERN WA/NRN ID AREA. AT THE SFC...COLD FRONT FROM NERN MN SEWD INTO SRN SD WILL PROGRESS STEADILY SEWD THROUGH THE PERIOD.

sections.title: UPPER/MID MS VALLEY EWD INTO THE CENTRAL GREAT LAKES
sections.text: LOW LEVEL WARM ADVECTION HAS SUPPORTED ELEVATED STORMS WITH SEVERE HAIL THROUGH THE MORNING ACROSS SERN MN. WIND DAMAGE WILL INCREASE LATER TODAY WITH THESE STORMS AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER WARMS AND EVENTUALLY SURFACE BASED STORMS/MCS EVOLVES...REFERENCE WW 616. AS SKIES CLEAR AND TEMPERATURES WARM...OTHER STORMS ARE LIKELY TO DEVELOP ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN WI THIS AFTERNOON AS STRONG LARGE SCALE LIFTING ASSOCIATED WITH UPPER LOW MOVES INTO THE REGION. STRONGLY-VEERING WIND PROFILES AND STRENGTHENING MID/UPPER LEVEL WINDS WOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH INITIAL STORMS. COMBINATION OF MODERATE INSTABILITY AND 40-50 KT DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL BE MOST FAVORABLE FOR STORMS WITH HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE...GIVEN THE FORECAST OF STRONG LOW LEVEL SHEAR/CURVED HODOGRAPHS...BUT EXPECT STRONG FRONTAL CONVERGENCE WILL RESULT IN STORMS EVOLVING INTO A LINEAR SYSTEM... WITH DAMAGING WINDS THEN BECOMING THE PRIMARY THREAT. THOUGH INSTABILITY WILL BE WEAKER...THE EXPECTATION OF AN ORGANIZED MCS AND STRONG FORCING MAY BE ENOUGH FOR THE SEVERE THREAT TO EXTEND INTO WRN LOWER MI OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: ERN NC/SC
sections.text: QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT WAS LOCATED IN ERN NC/SC. GIVEN JET STREAK IN REGION AND UPPER LEVEL DIFFLUENCE...STORMS ARE LIKELY TO DEVELOP ALONG AND EAST OF BOUNDARY. MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND COLD TEMPERATURES ALOFT...-10C AT 500 MB...WILL SUPPORT STRONG INSTABILITY. THE SHEAR/INSTABILITY WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS DURING THE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING HOURS.

sections.title: NRN GREAT DIVIDE
sections.text: TSTMS HAVE PERSISTED INTO THE MORNING HOURS WITHIN WARM CONVEYOR BELT EAST OF UPPER LOW. AS MODERATE INSTABILITY DEVELOPS WITH DIURNAL HEATING...THE POSSIBILITY OF A FEW SUSTAINED STORMS/SUPERCELLS WILL EXIST OVER WRN MT AND NRN ID INTO THE EVENING HOURS.

sections.title: CENTRL PLAINS
sections.text: COMBINATION OF APPROACHING COLD FRONT AND HEATING OF MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER MAY ALLOW ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS TO FORM THIS AFTN ...ESPECIALLY AS ELY UPSLOPE WINDS OCCUR BEHIND FRONT OVER WRN NEB/ERN WY. HOWEVER...MODELS SUGGEST CAPPING INVERSION WILL PREVAIL OVER THE REGION AND SINCE THE MAIN FORCING WILL BE LOCATED ACROSS THE MID/UPPER MS VALLEY...ONLY LOW PROBS ARE FORECAST ATTM.

sections.title: NY/PA SEWD INTO DELMARVA
sections.text: AS SHORTWAVE TROUGH PIVOTS NEWD ACROSS ENE NY AND PA...500 MB TEMPERATURES AROUND -14C AND SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE 70S WILL YIELD MLCAPES FROM 1000-2000 J/KG. ALTHOUGH DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS NOT EXPECTED TO BE PARTICULARLY STRONG...AT 20-30 KT...-14C AT 500 MB/ AND A BELT OF MODERATE MID LEVEL WINDS MAY SUPPORT STORMS WITH 3/4 TO 1 1/4 INCH HAIL DURING THE AFTERNOON HOURS. ..IMY/GARNER .. 07/24/2009

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST...MID-UPPER MS VALLEY REGION
sections.text: SVR PROBABILITIES ADJUSTED IN ACCORDANCE WITH CONVECTIVE AND CLOUD TRENDS...AND RELATED STABILIZATION OF AIR MASS N AND NE OF SUPERCELL-ANCHORED MCS NOW MOVING SEWD OVER PORTIONS NERN IA...SERN MN AND SWRN WI. WHILE ADDITIONAL TSTMS MAY FORM OVER CENTRAL/NRN WI INVOF SFC FRONT...MORE ORGANIZED SVR THREAT THEREWITH NOW APPEARS TO BE OVER SRN MN AND IA...ALONG AND W OF INSTABILITY GRADIENT ASSOCIATED WITH OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM ONGOING COMPLEX. REF SPC WWS 616-617 AND RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR NEAR-TERM DETAILS.

sections.title: ERN KS TO NRN OZARKS REGION...LATE TONIGHT
sections.text: LOW LEVEL WAA REGIME AND ISENTROPIC LIFT TO LFC ARE EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE TO TSTM DEVELOPMENT BEHIND SFC COLD FRONT AFTER APPROXIMATELY 09Z OVER PORTIONS NERN/E-CENTRAL KS AND SWRN MO...WITH ISOLATED SVR HAIL POSSIBLE. ANY SUCH ACTIVITY WILL BE ROOTED IN 650-800 MB LAYER...WITH ENOUGH MOISTURE IN INFLOW REGION TO SUPPORT ELEVATED MUCAPE 500-1000 J/KG. MID-UPPER LEVEL NNW FLOW AND LOW LEVEL SWLY-WLY WINDS ARE FCST ACROSS PORTIONS ERN KS/WRN MO EARLY IN PERIOD...CONTRIBUTING TO FAVORABLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR PROFILES FOR ORGANIZED TSTMS.

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: INCREASING POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED SVR EXISTS INVOF WRN SEGMENT OF SFC FRONTAL ZONE...ALONG AND E OF HIGHER TERRAIN IN SERN WY AND NERN CO. 5-PERCENT PROBABILISTIC OUTLOOK LINES HAVE BEEN MODIFIED ACCORDINGLY. REF MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1660 FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS. ..EDWARDS.. 07/24/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1127 AM CDT FRI JUL 24 2009/

sections.title: CNTRL PLAINS THROUGH MID-UPPER MS VALLEY AND UPPER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: A SWD MOVING COLD FRONT STRETCHES FROM NRN WI SWWD THROUGH CNTRL IA THEN WWD THROUGH SRN NEB. THE 00Z RAOB DATA INDICATES A RESERVOIR OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH 1500-2500 J/KG MLCAPE IN WARM SECTOR FROM NEB EWD THROUGH IA...NRN MO AND NWRN IL WHERE PLUME OF STEEPER LAPSE RATES HAVE OVERSPREAD MOIST AXIS WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO AROUND 70. STORMS FROM ERN IA THROUGH NRN IL HAVE EVOLVED INTO A SMALL MCS BUT WITH EMBEDDED ORGANIZED STRUCTURES. INCREASING STORM RELATIVE INFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH DEVELOPING SWLY LOW LEVEL JET AND NWLY FLOW ALOFT SHOULD CONTINUE TO PROMOTE SSEWD DEVELOPMENT OF THIS ACTIVITY WHERE CAP IS WEAKER ALONG INSTABILITY GRADIENT NEXT FEW HOURS. SOME WWD BACKBUILDING THROUGH SRN IA REMAINS POSSIBLE. NWLY BULK SHEAR OF 35-45 KT WILL SUPPORT EMBEDDED SUPERCELL AND BOWING SEGMENTS WITH DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL THE MAIN THREATS. HOWEVER...ISOLATED TORNADOES ALSO REMAIN POSSIBLE NEXT COUPLE HOURS. FARTHER WEST ACROSS NEB...MORE ISOLATED STORMS ARE DEVELOPING ALONG THE SWD ADVANCING COLD FRONT WHERE CAP IS STRONGER. THE 00Z OMAHA RAOB SUGGESTS SURFACE BASED CONVECTIVE INHIBITION SHOULD INCREASE SIGNIFICANTLY AS NOCTURNAL COOLING COMMENCES AND WOULD INDICATE

sections.title: NERN STATES
sections.text: LARGE SCALE LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH VORT MAX MOVING THROUGH THE NERN STATES IS SHIFTING EAST OF MODEST INSTABILITY AXIS. THREAT FOR ISOLATED HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND MAY PERSIST FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO WITH ONGOING MULTICELL STORMS...BUT OVERALL TREND SHOULD BE FOR STORMS TO WEAKEN AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO STABILIZE.

sections.title: WRN MT
sections.text: ISOLATED STORMS WILL CONTINUE DEVELOPING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN NEXT COUPLE HOURS WITHIN ZONE OF DEEPER ASCENT RESULTING FROM NEWD EJECTING VORT MAX. WHILE BULK SHEAR OF 30-40 KT WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELL STRUCTURES...MUCH OF THIS REGION HAS BEEN STABILIZED SOMEWHAT BY PREVIOUS CONVECTION AND ANY REMAINING SEVERE THREAT SHOULD BE VERY ISOLATED. ..DIAL.. 07/25/2009
